title: Microsoft Edge: simplified energy saver with new defaults and one mode
summary: The briefing accurately separates Microsoft's planned simplified energy saver from today's documented policies. The roadmap supports the new default and migration rules, and Microsoft Learn confirms the existing Group Policy paths and registry values.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans simplified energy saver in Microsoft Edge.
claims.quote: Microsoft Edge: Simplified Energy Saver

claims.claim: Energy saver was formerly known as efficiency mode.
claims.quote: Energy saver, formerly known as efficiency mode, will have new defaults and different setting options.

claims.claim: The planned simplified feature has two activation conditions: low battery or unplugged.
claims.quote: The energy saver feature has been simplified to become enabled under two conditions: on low battery or when unplugged.

claims.claim: Simplified energy saver will have one mode.

claims.claim: Today's EfficiencyMode policy configures when energy saver becomes active.
claims.quote: This policy setting lets you configure when energy saver becomes active.

claims.claim: The Group Policy path is Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge > Performance > Configure when energy saver (previously named efficiency mode) should become active.
claims.quote:
GP name: Configure when energy saver (previously named efficiency mode) should become active
GP path (Mandatory): Administrative Templates/Microsoft Edge/Performance

Value name: EfficiencyMode
Value type: REG\_DWORD

claims.claim: Today's EfficiencyModeEnabled policy controls whether efficiency mode is enabled.
claims.quote: Enables efficiency mode which helps extend battery life by saving computer resources.

claims.claim: The Group Policy path is Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge > Performance > Efficiency mode enabled.
claims.quote:

GP path (Mandatory): Administrative Templates/Microsoft Edge/Performance

claims.claim: The EfficiencyMode reference states that today's default is BalancedSavings.
claims.quote: By default, energy saver is set to 'BalancedSavings'.

claims.claim: BalancedSavings is listed for Edge 106 or later on Windows and macOS.
claims.quote:
BalancedSavings (4) = When the device is unplugged, energy saver takes moderate steps to save battery. When the device is unplugged and the battery is low, energy saver takes extra steps to save battery.
Windows: ≥ 106
macOS: ≥ 106

claims.claim: MaximumSavings is listed for Edge 106 or later on Windows and macOS.
claims.quote:
MaximumSavings (5) = When the device is unplugged or unplugged and the battery is low, energy saver takes extra steps to save battery.
Windows: ≥ 106
macOS: ≥ 106

claims.claim: The other four EfficiencyMode values are listed only for Edge 96-109 on Windows and macOS.
claims.quote:
AlwaysActive (0) = Energy saver is always active
Windows: 96-109
macOS: 96-109
NeverActive (1) = Energy saver is never active
Windows: 96-109
macOS: 96-109
ActiveWhenUnplugged (2) = Energy saver is active when the device is unplugged

claims.claim: Today's energy saver is enabled by default on devices with a battery.
claims.quote: By default, efficiency mode is enabled for devices with a battery and is disabled otherwise.
